questions.stem: A shape is enlarged by scale factor $-2$ from a centre of enlargement. Which statement is correct?

options.text: The image is the same size and on the same side of the centre
The image is twice as large and on the opposite side of the centre
The image is half the size and on the opposite side of the centre
The image is twice as large and on the same side of the centre

questions.explanation: A negative scale factor means the image appears on the opposite side of the centre of enlargement, and the absolute value $|-2| = 2$ gives the size multiplier. So the image is twice as large and inverted through the centre.
